definitions: Fully and freely enjoying oneself without thought to past or future.

blocks.text: In the Moment is the second studio album by American DJ and producer Kaskade. It was released on May 18, 2004, by OM Records.

In the Moment is the fourth and final album by jazz trio Gateway, consisting of guitarist John Abercrombie, bassist Dave Holland and drummer Jack DeJohnette, recorded in December 1994 and released on ECM in 1996.
